author: petr1petr
body:
Yes, since BoG is one of the best drops in game, it is quite rare and the chance that it will drop is rather small

It is not unfair towards you - how could it be unfair? you have same chance as everyone else - so it is perfectly fair - RNG is RNG

Comparing it with friend, who got superlucky does not really mean anything, and you should not do it. if you want to compare, compare with higher sample - like 1000 players. 

some of my friends got 2nd BoG only after 7k dungeons+ 

sidenote - some people like to farm T1 hard dungeons for BoGs - it is faster and you should get better quality - ofc, it will cost you a lot of keys.

author: JohnQ1024
body:
It is random, but there are ways to increase the odds.

1. hard mode drops more Eod and guarantees superior and above quality

2. Themed Dungeons and exploration Dungeons drop more Eod. 

3 Monuments and TowerTitans (very new) also drop Eod and hard mode towers also guarantee the quality to be superior or above.
